pages.text: $(italic)Mobile glass cannon. Maximum ranged damage. Paper-thin defenses. Don't get hit.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -20%  |  Equipment HP: $(bold)Halved$() (glass cannon)$(br)$(bold)Armor Penalty:$() -3 armor

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Swift$() — +15% movement speed. The fastest class. Combined with +10% attack speed, the $(thing)Ranger$() is built for kiting and repositioning.$(br2)$(bold)Eagle Eye$() — +20% projectile damage. Arrows and thrown weapons hit significantly harder.$(br2)$(bold)Glass Cannon$() — Equipment HP bonuses from Vitality enchant, HP affixes, and armor attributes are halved. Base HP, Spice of Life food HP, and level-up HP are unaffected.

pages.title: Risk and Reward
pages.text: The $(thing)Ranger$() has the highest ranged DPS in the game but dies in 2-3 hits from endgame content. Positioning is everything.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Elf$() — +10% speed stacks with Swift for extreme mobility. Night vision for dungeon safety.$(br)$(thing)Halfling$() — Smaller hitbox + food efficiency for sustained kiting.$(br)$(thing)Human$() — No weaknesses, +15% XP to reach glass cannon safety thresholds faster.
